abilities.name: MaxHP Buff - Any St. - Wi.
lines: When in Any Stance: Increases max HP of all allies +250 \ +500 \ +750 \ +1000 (1 turn)
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Wind type moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
